page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn1ne.4xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated physical cores on an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz. The instance is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 2.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, relying on external network-attached storage and featuring a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Benchmark data reveals a clear performance tradeoff between single-threaded and multi-threaded execution. Single-core performance is weak, with stress-ng single-core and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the bottom 10% to 25% categories. However, the 16 dedicated physical cores allow multi-threaded workloads to reach average performance levels. This is demonstrated by average ratings in Geekbench multi-core, software compilation, and ray tracing benchmarks. Memory bandwidth and database operations also perform in the middle 50% tier, though Passmark memory scores remain weak.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, this instance offers a high density of dedicated physical cores for parallel processing without the premium cost of high-capacity memory or local NVMe storage. It is best suited for multi-threaded, CPU-bound workloads that do not require high single-threaded speed or massive memory footprints. Appropriate workloads include software compilation, multi-threaded decompression, static web serving, and moderate database operations.
